modals.recalculateCostsAfterDeleteNote: Deleting details changed the container total volume. Transport cost and import price of the remaining details need to be recalculated with the new total volume.
modals.translateHqDataContent: Products in HQ container {{containerNumber}} whose English name is empty or contains Chinese will be machine-translated and written directly to the HQ product dictionary (valid English names are kept). Continue?
modals.mergeDomesticProductContent: A domestic product with Australian code {{newCode}} already exists. Change code {{oldCode}} in domestic products and containers to {{newCode}} and merge the old record into it?
modals.mergeDomesticProductScope: {{details}} detail line(s) in {{containers}} container(s) will be re-pointed. Their own prices and packing quantities stay unchanged.
modals.mergeDomesticProductRule: The existing record wins; its empty fields are filled from the old record. The old record is marked deleted and can be restored.
modals.mergeDomesticProductNoDiff: Both records have the same values. Nothing to fill.

messages.detailsDeletedCostsRecalculateCancelled: Recalculation cancelled. Remaining details still use the pre-deletion total volume for transport cost
messages.detailsDeletedCostsRecalculateFailed: Details deleted, but cost recalculation failed: {{message}}
messages.createProductsPushHqUnsent: {{count}} newly created product(s) could not be sent to HQ automatically (no sendable detail found). Please use "Send to HQ" manually
messages.createProductsPushHqBusy: Another Send to HQ job is being submitted, so HQ was not updated automatically. Please use "Send to HQ" later
messages.domesticProductMergedFilled: Merged into existing domestic product {{newCode}}. Filled: {{fields}}
